cycle.note: Virginia checks CPE by calendar year: 120 hours over the rolling three calendar years ending this year, at least 20 hours and a 2-hour VBOA-approved ethics course every year. You have until January 31 to finish the previous year's hours.

requirements.label: Three-year total
requirements.note: The three calendar years ending this year must reach 120 hours (18VAC5-22-90).

requirements.label: Minimum each year
requirements.note: At least 20 hours every calendar year, including the ethics course.

requirements.label: VBOA-approved ethics
requirements.note: A VBOA-approved ethics course of at least 2 hours every calendar year (it includes the VBOA segment). We count courses with "Virginia" and "ethics", or "VBOA", in the title.

requirements.label: Attest, compilation or financial statement preparation
requirements.note: If you provide attest, compilation or financial statement preparation services: at least 8 hours a year related to those services.

newLicensee.note: Licensed this calendar year: you're considered to have met this year's CPE (18VAC5-22-90 B).

practiceOptions.label: Attest, compilation or financial statement preparation

licenseDateHint: Virginia licenses renew every year by June 30. CPE is tracked by calendar year regardless.
issueDateHint: If you were licensed this year, no CPE is due this year. In the next two years only each year's 20 hours and ethics course apply.
limitsNotTracked: Presentations and teaching: max 30 hours per three-year period.
Published materials: max 30 hours per three-year period.
Certifications and exams: max 60 hours per three-year period.
January grace: hours finished by January 31 can count for the previous year (each course counts toward one year only) — enter them as you report them.
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for the four calendar years before the current year.
toVerify: Attest/compilation/preparation hours matched to the NASBA Accounting and Auditing fields.
VBOA-approved ethics matched by course title ("Virginia"+"ethics" or "VBOA"); a general ethics course counts only as general CPE.
New licensee: licensed last year or the year before → only the yearly minimums for the years after licensure, no 120-hour total (18VAC5-22-90 B).
